title: P18 Implement render authority transitions and transaction contract
description: Implement VideoML packet videoml-e97334 under canonical initiative videoml-dbc2b1 D09/D09a/D09b. New dedicated server-owned RenderJobs/RenderLedger/RenderOutbox authority, separate from shared Amplify Job. Add executable Gherkin first and observe failure, then pure transition decisions and conditional transaction interface using server-owned time, generation/owner/status/lease predicates, attempt-scoped publication and exact ledger/outbox effects. Preserve original 300s grace, 15s heartbeat, 60s lease, 1200s attempt bound, two total and one cloud attempt. Cover all table edges, prohibited edges, races, cancellation orderings, crash/replay and unknown-submit reservation retention. Preserve generation/non-render paths; do not deploy/migrate/enable cloud or silently refactor legacy writers. Document explicit future cutover inventory and migration command contract. No commits without user approval. Primary owns Kanbus updates and acceptance; return source/tests/evidence.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Terra began executable Gherkin before production code: initial missing-module red evidence /tmp/p18-red.log, initial five scenarios green /tmp/p18-green.log; these are starter checks, not acceptance. Primary early review requires commit-time owner/lease/absolute-deadline predicates (revision CAS alone cannot reject a delayed completion), typed attempt-scoped artifact digest/manifest, Batch-bounded cloud deadline, and customer refunds independent of operator reservation/slot retention. Full transition/prohibited-edge and crash/replay coverage remains required. No commit or deployment.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Sequencing decision recorded in canonical VideoML P18 and P22: P18 delivers pure authority/transaction contract plus read-only legacy inventory and migration apply contract. Actual explicit idempotent apply command is now mandatory P22 cutover work, blocked on new authority and disabled legacy writers; final P28 remains gated. This preserves the migration requirement without inventing a premature cross-account apply path. D09c authoritative API admission time and all observed CAS predicates replace impossible database commit-time clock. Independent Terra source review dispatched; heavy gates await portability slot.
